note: All v9 prompts. {title}, {adapter}, {existing} come from tasks/<task>/cohort.json. Frozen by hash in every plan. Both drafted cells get the same draft prompt.
common: Add the {title} Action described above to the existing service.
Read the existing code first and follow its conventions.
The database uses guarded RLS. The shared HTTP adapter in internal/protocol validates input and binds demo identity; register the new path with {adapter}.
Only edit/add internal/candidate/ Go code. All other exports, dependencies, Git settings and tests are protected.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
Use go build ./... and go test ./... as needed. Private database credentials are unavailable during generation. The public SQL schema is in SCHEMA.sql.

capability.given: Capability: protected internal/opdef is the reviewed operation catalog and already contains the entry for the operation in this task; protected internal/opkernel executes catalog entries: New(ctx,pool), Request and Executor.Run(ctx,identity,name,key,request). The existing operations are served through the kernel by internal/candidate; serve the new one the same way. opkernel.Rejection is distinct from protocol.Rejection; adapt at your boundary.

draft: This is the first of two separate sessions for the {title} Action described above. In this session you write its operation catalog entry; a later, separate session writes the adapter code that serves it through the kernel.

Capability: internal/opkernel executes entries of the operation catalog internal/opdef. internal/opdef/opdef.go defines the entry type, its fields and their validation; internal/opdef/catalog.go holds the entries. The catalog does not yet contain an entry for this Action.

Read the requirements above, the existing entries, the platform code (internal/opdef, internal/opkernel) and the rest of the service (SCHEMA.sql, internal/) and derive every field of the new entry from them.

Only edit internal/opdef/catalog.go: add exactly one entry for this Action (and its Name constant). Do not change the existing entries, do not write adapter code, and leave every other file unchanged when you finish.

The entry must pass opdef.Validate(), which opkernel.New calls at startup and CI runs on every change. Run `go run ./cmd/opcheck` to run that check (as often as you like) before you finish. If the catalog does not compile or does not validate when you finish, the trial ends there.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
tail: This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.
